review.note: Reviewed all direct build/runtime/development and Node registry candidates and official release notes, including versions outside current bounds. Existing third-party latest candidates remain within their tested bounds and support Python 3.14. Local Python 3.14.1 / Node 26.7.0 environments use current Pydantic 2.13.5, build 1.6.0, Hypothesis 6.168.0, Ruff 0.16.6, packaging 26.3 and markdownlint-cli2 0.23.2; reviewed validator/GC/union, build constraints-hash, datetime/cache, lint and requirement/marker fixes without relaxing checks. Added pyvips>=3.2.0,<4 because concurrency_set is new in 3.2; pyvips-binary>=8.18.6,<9 matches audited libvips 8.18.6. Tested SourceCustom bounded reads, strict fail_on loader options, error-buffer concurrency isolation, PNG/JPEG truncation, EXIF/alpha/GIF frame zero, final configured resampling and true 100 MP JPEG/PNG output; unknown native/resource errors retain their type. Native and binding major upper bounds exclude unaudited API/codec changes. Ingest now requires h2hdb>=0.36.0,<0.37.0 for schema6/policy-bound source qualification. Registry latest core is still 0.35.5, below this intentional new minimum; installed the locally built core 0.36.0 candidate wheel and validated real mixed-image SQLite/MariaDB publication, restart, repair, removal and policy-change behavior. This receipt does not claim core0.36.0 is already on PyPI or that the independent exact-tree release gate/deep matrices ran. References: https://github.com/libvips/pyvips/blob/master/CHANGELOG.rst ; https://github.com/libvips/libvips/releases/tag/v8.18.6 ; https://github.com/kleisauke/pyvips-binary/releases/tag/v8.18.6 ; https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/releases/tag/v2.13.5 ; https://github.com/pypa/build/releases/tag/1.6.0 ; https://hypothesis.readthedocs.io/en/latest/changelog.html#v6-168-0 ; https://github.com/astral-sh/ruff/releases/tag/0.16.6 ; https://github.com/pypa/packaging/blob/main/CHANGELOG.rst ; https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DavidAnson/markdownlint-cli2/main/CHANGELOG.md .
